A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PriorDiffusion study and contain readable methods, equations, experiments, figures, tables, and the complete six-page supplement, Appendices A–C. The shorter v3 does not omit experimental material.

before.justification: v2 reports original depth-estimation results, convergence experiments, qualitative comparisons, and prompt ablations in Section 4 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results, including Tables 1–5 and the main-text and supplementary visual comparisons.

M1.justification: The architecture, image-and-text conditioning, diffusion processes, loss, and inference procedure remain unchanged. The v-objective description omitted from v3's main implementation paragraph remains in Appendix B.2.

E1.justification: Both versions train on HyperSim and Virtual KITTI 2 and evaluate on NYUv2, KITTI, ETH3D, and ScanNet. The small-area, prompt, and misleading-description scenarios are retained. Figure 7's corrected dataset label does not introduce new coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across Tables 1–5 and the visual comparisons, including Marigold variants, GeoWizard, and Depth Anything variants. Newly cited works in related work are not added experimental baselines.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, sample counts, metrics, training budgets, and inference settings are unchanged. HyperSim distance conversion and Virtual KITTI cropping and the 80-meter cap are shortened out of the main text but retained in Appendix A.1.

E4.justification: Both retain the convergence and denoising-step studies, small-area evaluation, prompt ablations, misleading-text failure case, and supplementary qualitative analyses. Figure 7's title correction leaves the analysis and curves unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed summaries, confidence intervals, significance tests, or comparable statistical uncertainty estimates. The point-estimate reporting practice is unchanged.

E6.justification: Section 4 newly reports approximately four days to reach convergence at 20,000 iterations on an RTX 3090. This adds a runtime outcome; all numerical entries in Tables 1–5 and the plotted curves remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The diffusion equations, loss, inference update, normalization, and evaluation formulas are retained. Changing y := h(·) to y := h(x) clarifies notation without substantively revising the mathematical formulation.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about language-guided depth perception, faster training convergence, fewer denoising steps, and zero-shot performance.

C2.justification: The explanations involving geometric constraints and diffusion initialization remain unchanged. Section 5 and Appendix C.4 retain the limitations concerning inaccurate or unavailable descriptions and the discussion of template prompts and language distribution shift.

D1.justification: v3 adds the approximately four-day training-time disclosure in Section 4. The RTX 3090 hardware and convergence near 20,000 iterations were already documented in v2's Appendix B.2. Other implementation details and the code-release promise remain available.

R1.justification: Section 2 removes a short background passage on self-supervised depth and sensor-based scale recovery, with associated citations. It adds OpenVLA, Metamorph, and Efficient Interactive 3D Multi-Object Removal citations and clarifies DepthCLIP's ordinal interpretation. Central positioning against diffusion and language-based depth methods remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Localized rewrites affect related work, problem formulation, training datasets, and implementation details, alongside paragraph merging and minor grammar edits. The main narrative and appendix organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 7's right-panel title changes from 'Subset of KITTI Evaluation Set' to 'Subset of NYUv2 Evaluation Set'; its curves, axes, and legend are unchanged. Text and bibliography reflow alter placement, while all figures and tables are retained.

improvement.justification: Correcting Figure 7's dataset label removes a misleading presentation error, and the new training-time disclosure improves computational transparency. Related-work coverage becomes narrower, but the central comparisons and experimental evidence remain intact. These are limited improvements rather than a substantive scientific advance.
